description: Verifies a GitHub, Stripe or generic HMAC webhook signature locally and explains why a mismatch happened. The signing secret is read ONLY from the environment variable named in secret_env; there is no parameter for a plaintext secret and one is rejected if supplied. The body is read as raw bytes from body_path. Returns match / no match plus diagnostics: whether the signature header is well-formed, whether the Stripe timestamp is outside the tolerance, whether the body looks reformatted (trailing newline, CRLF, re-serialized or pretty-printed JSON) and common secret mistakes (whitespace, wrong key type). It sends nothing over the network and never returns the secret or a computed signature.

algorithm.description: HMAC hash for provider "generic" (default sha256). Not used by github or stripe.

body_path.description: Path to a file holding the RAW request body exactly as received (not re-serialized). Read as bytes, up to 10 MiB.

provider.description: github: X-Hub-Signature-256 (sha256=<hex>). stripe: Stripe-Signature header (t=...,v1=...). generic: plain HMAC over the body, hex (or base64) signature.

secret_env.description: NAME of the environment variable that holds the signing secret (for example GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Never the secret itself.

signature.description: The signature header value as received. It is not a secret.

tolerance_seconds.description: Stripe only: maximum allowed age of the signed timestamp in seconds (default 300).

name: verify_webhook
title: Verify a webhook signature offline
